An Easy Monday!

Tonight my streak hit 4,000.  By my calculation, that's 1,023,336 squares (black, white, and the occasional color or shape), countless Aha! moments, and occasional exasperation.  And somehow, I still look forward to tomorrow's puzzle.

My heartfelt thanks to Will, his brilliant team, the hundreds of ingenious constructors, and our NYTXW community (yes, you guys!) for making this daily ritual such a fulfilling break from—and connection to—the bigger world.

My sage crossword advice?  Take life one square at a time.

Immediately, in the NW corner, are three Down clues that pique my curiosity.  How unusual on a Monday.  How welcome!  I can see that this will be a Monday with lively cluing that's a bit out of the ordinary.  Where I'll actually have to do some thinking.  Max, you can make my Monday puzzles any time.

Let's also talk about Max's choices and the wonderful things he DIDN'T do.  Yes we do have SINATRA and EVE and ORR and ISSA, but they're pretty well known.  I didn't know KIRBY, but that may just be me.  But there were many opportunities for other pop culture names and Max avoided them all.  We didn't have to know any ROGERs or DUSTYs or LULUs. We didn't have to know either Martin or Kingsley (27A).  And we didn't have to know the song from "Cats" (68A) -- even though I do and can actually sing it.

These are conscious choices, constructors.  To my way of thinking, they are good choices.  I liked this much more than most Monday puzzles and hope to see more of Max in the future.
